summary: Relatives allege a pregnant woman was kicked in the stomach by several miscreants in Kalapara, Patuakhali, leading to a miscarriage and the death of her newborn. Police are investigating the incident.

Relatives allege that Habir was taking his pregnant wife, Tania Begum, to the hospital when local miscreants Sohagh, Mamun, and Shaon stopped their auto-rickshaw. They reportedly assaulted Tania's husband and father-in-law.

headline_marked: [[Athlete stopped at Dhaka metro station for 'obscene' shorts]]; authorities embarrassed
headline: Athlete stopped at Dhaka metro station for 'obscene' shorts; authorities embarrassed
summary: A triathlete was allegedly prevented from entering a metro station in Dhaka due to his shorts being deemed 'obscene' by officials. Dhaka Mass Transit Company Limited (DMTCL) has expressed embarrassment over the incident and is investigating.
details: Triathlete Sajjad Hossain Snigdho was allegedly stopped from entering Dhaka's Farmgate metro station on Sunday. Police officials reportedly deemed his shorts "obscene," preventing his entry.

Sajjad, who had just finished a training session at Ramna Park, was en route to Zia Udyan for another. He questioned the officers about the specific rule prohibiting shorts and the definition of "obscene" attire.

According to Sajjad's Facebook post, the officers allegedly laughed at and harassed him. When he contacted their superiors, they initially supported the officers' stance, and officials reportedly took photographs of him.

After approximately 40 minutes, senior officials eventually granted Sajjad permission to travel by metro. A metro staff member, Puja Ghosh, allegedly told him that "these things don't go with Bangladesh."

Major (retd) Mohammad Zakir Siddique, Deputy General Manager (Security) of Dhaka Mass Transit Company Limited (DMTCL), expressed embarrassment over the incident. He stated that the authorities have taken note and will discuss the matter with the managing director.

Siddique acknowledged that DMTCL is already addressing various issues and emphasized the need to avoid further controversy. He confirmed that a written complaint has been lodged and the matter will be examined for necessary action.
